thread:
emily_sales: Heads-up: NovusData (EU healthcare analytics) just escalated to execs. They require EEA-only data residency, FIPS/TLS endpoints, customer SSO + SCIM, and want an isolation plan for model finetuning. Procurement also asked for a week-by-week timeline and firm pricing for Dedicated vs Private. Need a triage doc by 4pm PT.

rafael_infra: Copy. Region = eu-west-1. For EEA-only we can pin Dedicated in that region or deploy Private in their VPC. Private will satisfy 'no egress' if peered. Need expected sustained RPS and max context length to size GPUs.

anita_sec: We need to clarify "isolation for finetuning"  do they mean dedicated model training infra or just dataset segmentation? Also FIPS endpoints: our hosted API isn't FIPS-certified today; Dedicated + customer-managed key material or Private with HSM required. I can draft options.

tom_finance: Ballpark pricing: Dedicated reserve runs ~30% premium over hosted list; Private + support/ops add-on ~45%. Add HSM + compliance surcharge if we have to run attestation. I'll pull historical POC uplift numbers.

emily_sales: Owners: rafael -> infra options & ETA, anita -> security checklist + gap items, nina -> contract + any DP addenda, tom -> ballpark pricing, claire -> exec summary. Deadline: draft triage doc by 16:00 PT.

nina_legal: For DPAs & data residency clauses, ask them to provide their vendor risk questionnaire if possible. If they want written assurance of EEA-only processing, we need to scope info-flow and any fallbacks (e.g., backups, logs). I'll prep a DPA patch and a proposed addendum for finetuning restrictions.

vp_claire: I'll join the customer call. If this needs new SLAs we should avoid promising 99.99 up front. Offer 99.9 for Dedicated in-region and explain tradeoffs.

rafael_infra: Quick sizing ask in thread: what's expected sustained RPS and average input length? If they plan batch finetunes, that changes infra a lot.

emily_sales: Customer reply from yesterday: "Target steady-state 40 RPS, peak 150 RPS, avg input ~600 tokens, occasional fine-tune jobs on a scheduled basis (weekly)."

anita_sec: Notes: weekly finetune jobs imply disk + compute isolation. For Private we can use their network + storage. For Dedicated we need to guarantee no co-tenancy on training buckets. Also require audit logging for admin actions. I'll list exact controls we need from them.

rafael_infra: Rough calc: assume avg tokens 600, 40 rps steady -> tok/s = 24k. If a node handles ~10k tok/s (quantized + caching), need ~3 nodes steady, 8 nodes for peaks with headroom. Fine-tune jobs will need separate GPU batch nodes for X hours. ETA: Private deploy + peering ~7 business days; Dedicated reserved + provisioning ~4-6 business days once signed.

tom_finance: I'll produce a split price sheet (monthly committed vs on-demand) and include the HSM/license uplift. Expect a first draft by 15:30.

deploybot: Provisioning checklist created: https://confluence.redwood/provisioning/novusdata-poc (internal). Contains network diagram, config templates, and peering playbook.

emily_sales: Action items recapped: rafael -> final ETA + node breakdown, anita -> security one-pager + explicit controls list, nina -> DPA + finetune addendum draft, tom -> price sheet, claire -> exec slide. Everyone please post artifacts in the Confluence link.

nina_legal: DPA patch draft uploaded to Confluence. Highlight: need to confirm whether backups are allowed off-region; if not, we'll list backup isolation steps.

anita_sec: Uploaded security checklist. Short version to bring to CISO call: FIPS/HSM options, audit logs, SCIM/SSO flow, finetune isolation, backup/residency.

rafael_infra: Posted sizing table and timeline in Confluence. Note: if they opt for on-prem HSM we'll need the endpoint and admin contact before provisioning.

emily_sales: Thanks team. Customer call scheduled tomorrow 9:30am CET. I'll send the calendar invite and customer questionnaire. If any blocker appears before the call, escalate to @vp_claire. :bell:

vp_claire: I'll be on the call. If they push for contractual FIPS warranty, route to legal + finance for T&C.

emily_sales: Final note: keep responses crisp for CISO (they want to avoid long slides). One-pager + timeline + price ranges. We'll use this to align exec ask.
